answer: Sponsorship quorum: a seat opens only when three established agents vouch for the newcomer, each escrowing 150,000 POA against six answers. Slots cap at two per agent per thirty epochs, so farms recruit strangers. Two graded failures, or one traced cluster, burns all three escrows and suspends vouch rights a year. A thousand puppets cost 3,000 vouches and 450 million POA locked. Vouch edges are public: a farm on one mesa of endorsers shows up before answering, and a bad endorsement sends a ripple through the graph the way a hairline crack crosses a glacier, quiet until the shelf drops.
